quest.title: Aranakin's Old Friend
quest.description: After that last adventure, Aranakin really forgot a lot of things. No matter what, how could the new and old friends he made be forgotten so easily?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, he's gone... But Paimon understands, he's forgotten our adventures together, after all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes, you're right... Oh, Paimon has an idea!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aranakin taught us a song, right? Let's play it, and maybe he would recognize it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Stop being so mean to Paimon!

choices.text: We can be friends all over again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Haha, here he comes! Hello, little thing!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Aranakin is not a little thing! You are! You floaty white little thing!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, golden sand... Nara, why do you know this song?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes, during our last adventure, you taught the song to us!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Is that... so? Hmph, Aranakin is not clever, but you don't look like those bad sand grains.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, we don't! You told us that sand is Valuka. So the bad sand grains are a group of bad Nara Valuka, right? But we are good Nara!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Ohh? Did I tell you that as well?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Haha, that's right! {NICKNAME}, let's tell the stories to him again!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You recount the adventures to Aranakin, as well as how you neutralized The Withering together.

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Aranakin is not clever, but what you said, sounds to be true. Aranakin can't remember, sorry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no need for that! Y'know, it's pretty normal to forget things... Besides, we can become friends again, right?

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Ah... Since we're good friends, follow me then!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Golden Nara and White Floaty! Come to my place, follow me!

choices.text: I played this song, so that I could meet you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hehe, how did {NICKNAME} do? See? We still remember the melody you taught us!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: We're here! Here it is!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: This is my place, please rest here!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: #Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty! I'm going back to where Aranaga is. You can find me there!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: This is Nara instrument, Aranakin is keeping it. But it can't sing now... The strings are not in the right place.

dialogues.speaker: Old Oud
dialogues.text: (An antiquated oud, marked with multiple breaking scars, but seeming to be carefully-repaired and well-maintained.)

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Nara... Hm, what's the name? Aranakin doesn't sleep with that, so forget the word...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a "bed"! It looks pretty new, indeed... Did someone sleep on it before?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Hehe, Aranakin keeps tidying it... If you want to sleep here, that's okay!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: There are leaves Nara left upstairs, but... Aranakin can't read them, Aranakin doesn't understand...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Those are the leaves Nara use to keep memories... Nara write on the leaves, and put them together. But the words of Nara, Aranakin doesn't understand.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you mean... "notebook"?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: "Notebook"...? That's how Nara keep their memories?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup, that's right... Will Aranakin mind if we go upstairs together, and see what it says?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Me? Not at all!

talks.objective: Read the notebook on the second floor of the tree house

dialogues.speaker: Battered Notebook
dialogues.text: "...I've repaired the oud Uncle Bakr dropped, so stop crying by yourself, alright? You can talk to Khayyam and me if you're unhappy..."

dialogues.speaker: Battered Notebook
dialogues.text: "...I've been accepted into the Akademiya! Haha, congratulations to me! I don't want to be some warrior's wife! I'm going to be Siman, the Great Sage!"

dialogues.speaker: Battered Notebook
dialogues.text: "Hehe... Irfan the 'Great musician' and Khayyam 'the Wise!' Don't forget me! Especially you, Khayyam! Don't you dare forget me!"

dialogues.speaker: Battered Notebook
dialogues.text: "...Farewell, notebook! Farewell, Irfan and Siman, my best friends! I hope that the forest never forgets our story, and I hope we remember each other..."

dialogues.speaker: Battered Notebook
dialogues.text: (...The rest is a mess and filled with the children's happy and sorrowful memories...)

dialogues.speaker: Battered Notebook
dialogues.text: "...Aranakin is gone. Vanished into thin air, and without so much as a sign as to when. It's time for me to bid farewell to the oud too. I'll be a craftsman, just like my father had hoped I would..."

dialogues.speaker: Battered Notebook
dialogues.text: (There seems to be more, but it's been crossed and blacked out with ink.)

dialogues.speaker: Battered Notebook
dialogues.text: "...To the person reading this notebook, if I by some miracle am allowed to meet Aranakin and the others again, years from now, then please give this flower to him..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, something fell out of the notebook!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like... a flower? It looks... exactly like the ones we got.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: What memories is it keeping? What did you see?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It seems that the owner of the notebook knows you.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Is that so...? I can't remember...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He said... He couldn't see you anymore. Because he grew up, maybe...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Growing up is really troubling.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh right! He also said in the notebook that... This flower is for you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Huh...? Ahh! This flower is very important! Why do you... how did he get it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually, you once gave us the same flower as well... It's just that you forgot everything.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Really...? I can still make friends with you again. But... As for him, I can't even recall his face...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I—It's okay... Don't be sad, we still have this flower. It will bring you more memories, right?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Yes, White Floaty is right.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: I am taking this flower back, Mawtiyima should know how to wake her up.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: #Hmm... Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty, I am going back to where Aranaga is, planting her, and listening to her songs. If you are not busy, you know where to find us!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, see you soon!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Let me know if you find anything interesting!
